sources.recommend_reason_zh: 开发者 WollyMonjac 用 Turbo C2.0 写出 38 万参数的小型问答 Transformer Tiny2.1，把它塞进一张软盘，让跑 DOS 的 486DX 和 Pentium 老电脑也能运行 AI，展示了一个架构与今天大模型同源、却把模型压到极致的复古项目。

en.title: A 380,000-parameter Transformer squeezed onto a floppy disk: a 30-year-old 486 can now "run AI
en.reason: Developer WollyMonjac built Tiny2.1, a 380,000-parameter question-answering Transformer in Turbo C 2.0, squeezed it onto a floppy disk, and runs it on DOS-based 486DX and Pentium PCs.
